rules.title: Confirm zoning and Certificate of Use route
rules.request: Could you confirm whether the proposed use is allowed and which Certificate of Use steps we should complete before the building application?
rules.outcome: City confirmation of use eligibility and the COU process
rules.source_title: Certificates of Use — How to Obtain a Certificate of Use, Steps 1–2
rules.guidance: The City describes COU as the first application for a business occupying space, with zoning approval before the proposed-use building application. COU issuance also involves building and fire reviews; a COU application is not final COU approval.
rules.exceptions: Existing approvals and unchanged use must be checked with Zoning. This rule sequences the preliminary use conversation, not final COU issuance.

rules.title: Confirm converting-use building review
rules.request: Could you confirm whether the existing and proposed activities require a converting-use building permit and what documents are needed?
rules.outcome: City/design-professional determination of occupancy and converting-use requirements
rules.source_title: Certificates of Use and Converting Use Building Permits — occupancy and drawings
rules.guidance: A conversion of occupancy classification or group may require a converting-use building permit even without physical work.
rules.exceptions: A business-use change alone does not establish an occupancy classification. Compare the actual activities and existing approvals with City staff.

rules.title: Confirm building permit scope
rules.request: Could you confirm the building permit route and drawings needed for the proposed alterations?
rules.outcome: Confirmed building scope and submission documents
rules.source_title: Online Permit Submission — agency, DSD and sufficiency review
rules.guidance: Building submissions can involve Development Services and other agencies; prerequisite reviews and sufficient documents are checked before building review.
rules.exceptions: Interior-work screening is preliminary. Cosmetic work and other scope-specific exceptions need staff confirmation.

rules.title: Confirm plumbing permit scope
rules.request: Could you confirm the plumbing permit and plan requirements for the proposed plumbing changes?
rules.outcome: Confirmed plumbing permit and document requirements
rules.source_title: Online Permit Submission — trade and building submission process
rules.guidance: Use the City's submission process to confirm the trade route. The plumbing trigger comes from the supplied preliminary routing matrix, not a universal rule established by this page.
rules.exceptions: New or modified plumbing is a preliminary matrix flag; City staff must establish the actual permit requirements.

rules.title: Confirm site-development review and prerequisites
rules.request: Could you confirm which site-development reviews apply and whether a City Development Number or preliminary site review is needed before plan submission?
rules.outcome: Confirmed site route, prerequisites and eligible submission stages
rules.source_title: Site Development Plan Review — triggers, submittal requirements and additional considerations
rules.guidance: Site review depends on development scope. CDN and applicable preliminary reviews precede construction-plan submission. Building and site permits have specific concurrent-review submission conditions.
rules.exceptions: Parking restriping alone and some ADA-only changes are excluded from the parking-layout trigger. Commercial-to-commercial conversions require site review only when another listed site trigger applies.

rules.title: Confirm right-of-way jurisdiction and permit route
rules.request: Could you confirm whether the work is within City right-of-way and which permit or other agency review applies?
rules.outcome: Confirmed jurisdiction and right-of-way review path
rules.source_title: Right of Way Permitting — requirements and jurisdiction notes
rules.guidance: Work affecting City roads, right-of-way or easements can require ROW permitting. Confirm jurisdiction before applying.
rules.exceptions: FDOT rights-of-way, private roads and non-City easements follow different paths. Residential irrigation extending into City ROW is addressed under plumbing; major utilities may need site-plan approval first.

rules.title: Confirm the appropriate specialty or agency review
rules.request: Could you identify the appropriate trade, fire or agency reviewer for the specific work described and confirm what they need before submission?
rules.outcome: Assignment to the appropriate specialty reviewers
rules.source_title: Online Permit Submission — agency review and Fire Marshal coordination
rules.guidance: Agency review is determined by scope and location; required approvals and supporting records form part of submission readiness.
rules.exceptions: HVAC or electrical work alone does not establish a Fire Prevention route. Fire and other agencies must be selected for the actual described scope.
